Exam Type: MRI KNEE LEFT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Bilateral knee pain for months.
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the left knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla extremity system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture or bone bruise. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
No joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. Small partially ruptured Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Medial compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: Full-thickness cartilage fissuring medial patellar facet and median ridge with subchondral bone marrow edema. Partial-thickness cartilage loss lateral patellar facet. Full-thickness cartilage fissuring central trochlea with subchondral cystic change and intense subchondral bone marrow edema.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: There is edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. There is lateral patellar tilt and translation. No patella alta. Shallow trochlea and elongated lateral patellar facet. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 10 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:
1.	Findings of active lateral patellar maltracking with high grade patellofemoral chondrosis.

Antecedentes Clínicos:
Obs. Lesión meniscal.
Hallazgos:
No hay alteraciones en significativas de la médula ósea.
Ligamentos cruzados y colaterales dentro de límites normales.
Aumento de señal central del cuerno posterior y parte del cuerpo del menisco medial que
impresiona contactar de manera periférica la superficie articular inferior, puede representar una
pequeña rotura.
Rotura a nivel de la unión de los fascículos poplíteo meniscales del cuerno posterior del menisco
lateral con desplazamiento de segmento hacia parte de la región intercondílea y adyacente al
cuerno anterior del menisco lateral.
Cartílagos del compartimento femorotibial lateral sin alteraciones significativas.
Úlceras condrales de espesor parcial de la región central de la zona de carga del cóndilo femoral
medial con algunos fenómenos condrales reparativos. El resto de los cartílagos del compartimento
femorotibial medial sin alteraciones. Úlceras condrales focales de espesor total de la región central
de la tróclea femoral con cambios óseos secundarios. Cartílago rotuliano dentro de límites
normales.
Leve a moderado derrame articular con discreta sinovitis. Discreto edema a nivel de la esquina
posterolateral de la rodilla sin alteraciones de las principales estructuras regionales.
Tendones cuadricipital, la pata de ganso, bíceps femoral y banda iliotibial dentro de límites
normales. Discreto aumento de señal del tercio proximal del tendón rotuliano, sin signos de rotura.
Impresión:
Rotura de la unión de los fascículos poplíteo meniscales del cuerno posterior del menisco lateral
con desplazamiento de segmento hacia la región intercondílea y adyacente al cuerno anterior del
menisco lateral.
Probable rotura periférica del menisco medial.
Condropatía lesiones grado 2 con fenómenos condrales reparativos de la región central de la zona
de carga del cóndilo femoral medial. Condropatía lesiones focales grado 3 y 4 de la tróclea
femoral.
Leve a moderado derrame articular con discreta sinovitis difusa.
Leve tendinosis rotuliana proximal.

MRI of right  Knee with 
-SG PD FatSat, Locator, SG T2W FS, SG T1W, CO T2W FS, AX T2W FS



> The contour of ACL is not in a straight line and increase signal intensity inside, in favor of tear.
>Increased signal intensity of PCL on T1WI, in favor of grade 1 injury.
> There are linear signal intensity in anterior and posterior horn of medial meniscus, it extends into the surface and relatively small size of posterior horn, in favor of tear.
> Linear signal intensity in posterior horn of medial meniscus, without significant extending into the surface, in favor of  grade 2 intrasubstance signal of posterior horn of medial meniscus, maybe due to degeneration.
> Both medial & lateral collateral ligaments appear to be within normal.
> Osteoarthritis of right knee with spur and subchondral cysts and subchondral edema in lateral femoral condyle; wearing of articular caritlage,grade 3-4. 
    Some losse bodies noted in right knee joint.
> Joint effusion and suprapatellar bursitis with suprapatellar and medial and lateral  plicae; hypertrophy of the synovium, indicative of synovitis.

Impression: 
1. C/W tear of ACL.
2. Tear of lateral meniscus and R/O degeneraiton of posterior horn of medial meniscus.
3. Osteoarthritis of right knee with synovitis; more severe at lateral compartment.
4. R/O grade 1 injury of PCL.
Suggest correlation with clinical manifestation

Findings:  There is a moderate knee effusion. There is a horizontal tear through the posteromedial corner of the medial meniscus. Normal lateral meniscus.  Normal ACL, PCL, MCL and LCL. Normal extensor mechanism.  The tibiofemoral articular cartilage is normal. Mild thinning of the medial compartment articular cartilage is noted.  
Conclusion: Tear of the posteromedial corner of the medial meniscus.

Exam Type: MRI KNEE RIGHT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: 2 years of pain with walking up and down the stairs twisting and squatting.
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the right knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system body coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture or bone bruise. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions. Tricompartmental marginal osteophytes

JOINT SPACE:
Small joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. No Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Extensive complete tearing of the body, posterior horn, and posterior root medial meniscus with severe extrusion.
Medial compartment cartilage: Full thickness cartilage loss along the medial femoral condyle and medial tibial plateau with subchondral cystic change and marrow edema.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Degenerative signal throughout the lateral meniscus without surfacing tear.
Lateral compartment cartilage: Mild cartilage heterogeneity and fissuring.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: High-grade cartilage loss along the medial patellar facet. High grade cartilage loss at lateral trochlea. 

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 17 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
Nonspecific prepatellar and scattered subcutaneous edema about the knee. No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:
1.	Extensive complete tearing of the body, posterior horn, and posterior root medial meniscus with severe extrusion.
2.	Tricompartmental osteoarthritis worse in the medial compartment.

Ön çapraz bağda hafif diffüz sinyal artışı mevcuttur.Arka çapraz bağ, lateral ve medial kollateral ligaman normaldir.Patellar kıkırdakta medial faset düzeyinde kartilajda fokal incelme ve komşu kemik yapıda subkondral kemik iliği ödemi ( grade II kondromalazi ) izlendi. Distal kuadriseps normaldir. Retinaküler devamsızlık yoktur.Eklemde sıvı artışı saptanmamıştır. Diz eklemini oluşturan kemik yapıların sinyal intensiteleri doğaldır.

МР находка: Костите, формиращи колянната става са със запазена форма и сигнална характеристика. Артикулиращия хрущял на фемура и тибията е запазен. Нормално изобразяване на кръстните връзки. Визуализира се лезия в задния рог на медиалния менискус. Лезията е с хоризонтален ход, като тя не достига ставните повърхности на фемура или тибията – 2а степен. Нормално изобразяване на латералния менискус. Колатерални лигаменти – нормално изобразяване. Патела, хрущял на пателата, ретинакулуми – нормално представени. Лигамент на пателата, сухожилие на м. квадрицепс феморис – без особености. Поплитеална ямка – б.о. Няма данни за ставен излив. SOL DİZ MRG. Tetkik protokolü: Çok düzlemli, çok sekanslı. Bulgular: Lateral menisküs normaldir.  Medial menisküs gövde ve arka boynuzda tibial eklem yüzeyi ile ilişkili horizontal yırtık izlendi. Arka kök lokalizasyonunda yırtık komşuluğunda 9 mm çaplı parameniskal kist mevcuttur.Ön çapraz bağ ve arka çapraz bağ, lateral ve medial kollateral ligaman normaldir.Distal kuadriseps ve patellar tendonlar normaldir. Patella normal yerleşimlidir. Retinaküler devamsızlık yoktur.Eklemde sıvı artışı saptanmamıştır. Diz eklemini oluşturan kemik yapıların sinyal intensiteleri doğaldır.Sonuç: Medial menisküste yırtık.

FINDINGS:

Fluid:
Moderate to large knee joint effusion and popliteal cyst. The popliteal cyst measures 2.7 cm x 2.1 cm x 4.2 cm in length. No cyst rupture.

There is osseous intra-articular body in the subpopliteus recess measuring 1.5 cm in total.

Medial compartment (meniscus, collateral ligament, cartilage):
No medial meniscal tear. There is mild to moderate cartilage thinning, which has progressed without full-thickness cartilage loss or reactive subchondral marrow changes. Marginal osteophytes are noted as well as peripheral medial tibial plateau intraosseous ganglion cyst.

Lateral compartment (meniscus, collateral ligament complex, cartilage):
Degenerative multidirectional tearing of the body and posterior horn of the lateral meniscus with a large radial oblique tear at the junction of the body and posterior horn. There is progression of the tear with further loss of substance when compared to previous MRI.
Severe chondropathy in the lateral compartment with full-thickness cartilage thinning, reactive subchondral marrow changes and osteophytes which have progressed.
Lateral supporting structures intact.

Intercondylar compartment (anterior and posterior cruciate ligaments):
Normal.

Anterior compartment (extensor mechanism, cartilage, Hoffa's fat pad):
Mild cartilage thinning at the patellar medial and lateral facet as well as the trochlear surface, with a full-thickness cartilage fissure at the lateral patellar facet and mild reactive subchondral marrow changes. Marginal osteophytes also noted. Extensor mechanism is intact

Bones:
As above

Muscles and neurovascular structures:
Normal.

Other findings:
None

CONCLUSION:

Tricompartmental chondropathy, severe in the lateral compartment, which have progressed. Osseous intra-articular body in the subpopliteus recess.

Multidirectional tearing of the lateral meniscus the body and posterior horn, which has progressed. Large radial oblique tear at the junction of the body posterior horn.

Moderate to large knee joint effusion and popliteal cyst.

ACL intact.

МР находка: Няма МР данни за ставен излив. Костите, формиращи дясната колянна става, се изобразяват с правилна форма, структура и сигнална характеристика. Няма данни за костномозъчен едем. Хрущялът, покриващ ставните повърхности на тибия, фемура и пателата, е с нормална дебелина, хомогенна структура и сигнален интензитет. Установява се хиперинтензна лезия в задния рог на медиалния менискус с кос ход, достигаща ставната повърхност на тибията. Латерален мениск-нормално изобразяване. Двата кръстни лигамента, както и двата колатерални лигамента се проследяват до залавните си места с правилна форма, хомогенна структура и сигнален интензитет. Пателарен лигамент и двата ретинакулума са с нормално представяне. Сухожилие на м. квадрицепс феморис – б.о. Наличие Фабела. Фоса поплитеа – б.о. Меки тъкани – нормално изобразяване. Заключение:  
МР данни за лезия в задния рог на медиалния менискус – 2b стадий.

Na nativnim presjecima kroz lijevo koljeno nalaze se uznapredovale osteoartritičke promjene
femorotibijalnog i femoropatelarnog zgloba uz osteofitozu zglobnih tijela, subtotalno, mjestimice
i potpuno reduciranu debljinu zglobnih hrskavica te vidljiv subhondralni edem zglobnih tijela. U
anteriornom dijelu tibije vidljivo je i nekoliko subhondralnih cisti degenerativne etiologije.
Zglobna tijela FT zgloba primjereno su uzglobljena. Visoki položaj patele (patella alta),
Insall-Salvati omjer oko 1,8.
Prednji križni ligament je izrazito degenerativno promijenjen, smanjene napetosti, vjerojatno
uslijed suženja zglobnog prostora, bez jasnih znakova rupture.
Stražnji križni ligament je primjerenih intenziteta signala i održanog kontinuiteta.
Medijalni menisk je stanjen, degenarativno promijenjen uz horizontalnu rupturu stražnjeg
korijena i stražnjeg roga koja se širi do artikulacijske plohe tibije te s ekstruzijom za 4 mm.
Degenerativno promijenjen lateralni menisk, bez znakova rupture.
Medijalni i lateralni kolateralni ligamenti su primjerenih intenziteta signala, održanog kontinuiteta.
Edem periligamentarno uz MCL, vjerojatno uslijed OA promjena.
Uredan prikaz tetive popliteusa, iliotibijalnog trakta i pes anserinus.
Tetiva kvadricepsa i patelarni ligament su primjerenih intenziteta signala, održanog kontinuiteta.
Patelarni retinakulumi održani.
Umjerena količina izljeva u zglobu.
Baker cista veličine oko 17 mm.
Prepatelarno edem potkožnog masnog tkiva.

There is a mild knee effusion. There is tearing of the posterior root of the medial meniscus with mild extrusion of the medial meniscal body from the joint. Normal lateral meniscus.  Normal ACL, PCL, MCL and LCL. Normal extensor mechanism.  There is mild thinning of the medial compartment articular cartilage but no underlying bony change. Normal lateral tibiofemoral and patellofemoral articular cartilage.  
Conclusion: Tearing of the posterior root of the medial meniscus. Mild medial compartment OA changes.
